az_acf_1_50.source: Autocorrelation of returns, lag 1, window 50, hand

az_acf_5_50.source: Autocorrelation of returns, lag 5, window 50, hand

az_adr_rel.source: Mean daily range/close over prior 14 completed days, hand

az_alligator_jaw.source: (close - SMMA13 of median price)/close, unshifted, pandas_ta

az_alligator_lips.source: (close - SMMA5 of median price)/close, unshifted, pandas_ta

az_alligator_teeth.source: (close - SMMA8 of median price)/close, unshifted, pandas_ta

az_donchian_pos.source: Position of close in Donchian channel(20), pandas_ta

az_dpo_20.source: Detrended Price Oscillator(20), causal form, hand

az_hist_vol_20.source: Historical volatility: rolling std(20) of log returns, hand

az_keltner_pos.source: Position of close in Keltner channel(20,2), pandas_ta kc

az_keltner_width.source: Keltner channel width / close, pandas_ta kc

az_klinger_diff.source: Klinger Oscillator(34,55) minus signal EMA(13), hand

az_pat_hammer.source: Hammer flag: lower wick >= 2x body, upper <= body

az_pat_marubozu.source: Marubozu: body >= 90% of range, signed by direction

az_pat_shooting_star.source: Shooting star flag (encoded -1): upper wick >= 2x body

az_pat_three.source: Three white soldiers (+1) / three black crows (-1), strong-body form

az_pivot_dist.source: (close - classic Pivot Point of prior completed day)/close, hand

az_pv_corr_20.source: Rolling corr(20) of price returns vs volume returns, hand

az_rel_vol_index.source: Relative Volatility Index (Beyers), rolling-std form, hand
